shared_prompt: Make ONE separate square game icon, PNG 512x512, for the action bar of Everkin, a night fairytale creature card battler. One bold central symbol readable at 64x64. Chunky low-poly faceted 3D storybook style: broad flat facets, matte colors, soft light upper left. Same full-bleed opaque dark plum-to-midnight-blue gradient background with faint vignette on every icon. Given main class color plus brighter accent glow, high contrast. No frame, no transparent border, no rounded corners. No text, letters, numbers, logos. Musical note pictograms allowed where requested, never alphabetic letters. Ages 7+, no blood, gore, or dripping skulls.
